title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by the entity, metric, decision and binding schemas. Schemas check one file's shape; everything that needs to look across files (an id exists, an option belongs to its decision, a variant is reachable) is the validator's job and is listed in the description of the definition it applies to.

kebab_id.description: A stable kebab-case identifier. Node ids must match their filename (validator).

decision_id.description: A decision id. Validator: the decision exists in src/decisions/. References to one of the 14 enumerated but not yet written decisions are warnings, not errors.

status.description: `draft` marks a branch deliberately incomplete and open to contribution, not a failure.

condition.description: A reference to a decision's answer. Used by a variant's `selected_when`, a decision's `applies_when`, and `required_when` on parameters and entity properties. Exactly one of `equals` / `in` / `not_equals` / `not_in`. Prefer the negative forms over listing the other options, which silently breaks when an option is added. Validator: the decision exists and every option id belongs to it.

parameter.description: A numeric or scalar knob: same model, different number. Declared on the decision or metric that reads it; a binding sets its value. Validator: a binding may set only declared parameters. Types are JSON's (`number`, not `decimal`): parameters are settings, not stored amounts. Entity properties use `decimal` because money must never be stored as a float.

source.description: A citation. Every claim about how a metric is usually defined, and every benchmark, needs one.
